Halloween After Dark Party | A Night at The Mint
San Francisco’s historic Mint transforms into a haunted playground for one unforgettable night of music, culture, and energy. Wander through the eerie halls, pick your vibe, and dance the night away across four immersive rooms, each offering a completely different experience.

A cultural celebration of Bollywood’s biggest bangers blended with Afro House’s hypnotic rhythms. Pure international dancefloor magic.
Room 2 – Persian / Middle Eastern / Arabic
A room filled with exotic rhythms and global flavor. From Persian beats to Arabic grooves, this space keeps the energy sensual, warm, and vibrant.
Room 3 – EDM / House / Top 40 / Club Anthems
Festival energy meets nightclub intensity. Expect big drops, remixes, chart-topping hits, and high-octane dance vibes all night long.
Room 4 – Latin
Turn up the heat with the best in Latin music. Dance to Reggaeton, Latin hits, Salsa and high-energy Latin rhythms all night long.

long_description:
Join us for this 1.15 hour Kundalini Experience with Brittani Nearing!

You must bring your own yoga mat

Have you ever wondered about the truth of who you are? The purpose of your life? Do you feel disconnected from the strength of the fire within you? Are you experiencing energetic imbalances or confusion around who you are and where you are going? Do you feel lost or uncertain on your path, but can’t quite hear your own voice clearly enough to know what you are meant to be doing?

Then Kundalini Yoga may be for you.

Kundalini is often described as the Divine Feminine energy that rests at the base of the spine—a powerful, creative life force that lives within each of us. In essence, it is the energy of your creative purpose in this lifetime: the wisdom, vitality, intuition, and inner knowing that are uniquely yours. Kundalini practice invites this energy to awaken, move, and rise through the body, helping us reconnect with the deepest truth of who we are and what we are here to express.

This powerful and beautiful practice blends movement, mantra, breathwork, meditation, and focused awareness to create greater balance within your physical, mental, emotional, and energetic bodies. Kundalini Yoga can help cultivate vitality, clarity, inner strength, nervous-system regulation, and a deeper connection to your intuition and highest self. Through the practice, we begin to quiet the outside noise and create space to hear the voice of our own truth.

And the magic deepens when we practice regularly. Kundalini is not simply something we experience on the mat and then leave behind. With consistent practice, we create a foundation for integrating the insights, shifts, emotions, and wisdom we encounter along our path. The practice gives our bodies, minds, and energetic systems the opportunity to process and embody what we are experiencing and learning, allowing those changes to become real, grounded, and lasting in our everyday lives.

title: Quick & Easy Indian Cooking
description: Learn how to the flavors found in Indian cuisine in your own kitchen. Hands-on. For ages 18+. You’ll work in small teams during class.
long_description:
Learn how to the flavors found in Indian cuisine in your own kitchen. Hands-on. For ages 18+. You’ll work in small teams during class.

About this Event

Age RestrictionsFor ages 18 & up

DescriptionIf you love Indian food and have wondered how to recreate those flavors in your own home, this is the class for you! While the South Asian/Indian culinary diaspora is incredibly diverse, we’re here to lessen the intimidation factor and help you get to know the key spices, knife skills, essential sauces, and cooking methods to get you started.
We’ll pay homage to Madhur Jaffrey, multiple James Beard Award-winner known as the Godmother of Indian Cooking for introducing many people to Indian food in America. Using her approach, we’ll keep class fun, easy, and delicious at every turn. At the end of class everyone will get to sit down and enjoy a meal together.
You will be working in a small group. For ages 18 and up. 21 or older? You’ll enjoy a glass of wine or beer paired with your meal.

MenuLamb Vindaloo
Shahi Murgh (Royal Chicken Cooked in Yogurt)
Massor Dal (Red Lentils Tarka)
Matar Aur Sooay Ka Pullao (Rice with Peas and Dill)
Hari Chutney (Fresh Green Chutney)
Sev ka Murabba (Carmelized Cardamom Apples with Pistachio Cream)

Safety & Precautions
At check-in, you will be asked to sign a waiver before entering the Cooking School.
For that reason, we ask that all attendees arrive at least 5 minutes prior to the confirmed start time of the class.

title: Diwali on the Square
description: Diwali on the Square
long_description:
Diwali on the Square

About this Event

🪔 DIWALI ON THE SQUARE 2026ONE SQUARE. MANY CULTURES. ONE BIG PARIVAR!
✨ San Francisco, let's celebrate Diwali together! Join ParivarBayArea for our inaugural Diwali on the Square, a spectacular evening of lights, culture, music, dance, delicious Indian food, festive shopping, henna, beauty, and community joy! We're bringing together an exciting and growing lineup of local vendors, artists, performers, small businesses, food entrepreneurs, and community organizations to create an unforgettable celebration. Shop our Diwali Bazaar, enjoy live performances, discover festive treasures, and make wonderful memories with family, friends, and neighbors. More exciting vendor and performer announcements are coming!
❤️ A New Home. A New Beginning. A Bigger Family! This Diwali is especially meaningful as ParivarBayArea celebrates its new chapter as an independent 501(c)(3) nonprofit and welcomes everyone to our new home at St. Mark's Square & Urban Life Center. Founded and led by the Kinnar-Hijrah community, rooted in Indian and South Asian heritage, and shaped by Global South immigrant experiences, we continue to grow while honoring our roots. We welcome immigrant families, elders, youth, LGBTQ+ communities, neighbors, and people of every faith, identity, and background. You don't have to be South Asian or Hindu to celebrate, and you don't have to spend Diwali alone. Come find your Parivar—your family!
🎉 Sunday, November 8, 2026 | 6:30–9:30 PM | St. Mark's Square, 1031 Franklin Street, San Francisco. Come dressed in your brightest festive colors, traditional attire, or simply as you are! Admission is FREE or pay what you can—no one turned away for lack of funds. Food, shopping, and optional vendor services may have separate costs. 🎟️ Tickets: https://tinyurl.com/diwalisf | Use code OURPARIVAR for 100% off admission! Vendors, performers, nonprofits, and community partners are still welcome to join us, with FREE vendor and community tablin

Celebrate Diwali with your loved ones at the Third Street Diwali Festival, a vibrant, family-friendly afternoon of art, rhythm, and community that brings the magic of the Festival of Lights to life through immersive cultural traditions. 
Observed by millions of people across India and the global South Asian diaspora, Diwali is a major five-day autumn festival symbolizing the spiritual victory of light over darkness, good over evil, and knowledge over ignorance. 
This joyful neighborhood gathering offers something special for children and adults alike, beginning in our outdoor courtyard transformed into a bustling oasis of artistic design where you can visit the booths of incredible local artists—Afreenz, Thuya, and Amoha—to get your own stunning, intricate henna patterns drawn. 
You can also get ready to move with an interactive dance workshop featuring New York’s premier South Asian performing arts organization, the Ajna Dance Company, known for blending classical Indian styles with high-energy Bollywood and Bhangra rhythms. Their professional teaching artists will have parents and kids grooving together.

title: Kundalini & Sound
description: Awaken energy through Kundalini Yoga, breath, movement, mantra, and meditation, then settle into a deeply restorative sound bath with Dinah.
long_description:
Awaken energy through Kundalini Yoga, breath, movement, mantra, and meditation, then settle into a deeply restorative sound bath with Dinah.

About this Event

Kundalini & Sound with Dinah Simpson is an immersive evening designed to awaken energy, cultivate connection, and create space for rest, reflection, and renewal.
Dinah will begin with a grounding and energizing Kundalini Yoga practice that weaves together breath, movement, mantra, and meditation. The evening will then transition into a deeply restorative sound bath, using an immersive soundscape to help guide the body and mind toward a state of deep relaxation and stillness.
Together, these practices create a balance of activation and rest, encouraging clarity, presence, and deeper awareness while offering space to soften, release, and fully arrive in the moment.
Options and modifications will be offered throughout, making the practice welcoming for both newer students and experienced practitioners alike.
Yoga on Connecticut, a community yoga project in partnership with Van Ness Main Street, is excited to offer yoga for the neighborhood—creating a space where movement, mindfulness, sound, and community can come together.
This is a donation-based class, with a portion of proceeds supporting the NW Community Food Bank and Van Ness Main Street, helping support the organizations and community that make these gatherings possible.
Please arrive a little early to settle in and set up your space before class begins.
Please note: This is a simple pop-up style class. Some props will be provided, but no yoga mats will be available. Please bring your own mat and any props you prefer. 18+.

About this Event

Join us again for a FREE celebration of tradition and enlightenment with our fourth annual Diwali Festival at the Outer Sunset Farmers Market & Mercantile. Featuring live music, chutney and sari demos by Shanta Sacharoff, henna by Hennapub, diya candle decorating 🪔 + rangoli sand art at Artship, pop-up South Asian vendors, and more! Did we mention free chai? 🫖 Yep, that too!
PLUS, our raffle is back with $100s in gift certificates and prizes from small neighborhood businesses like Arizmendi Bakery, Henry's House of Coffee, Judahlicious, and more! 🎁 Check out our pinned Instagram post (@outersunsetfarmersmarket) for info on how to buy tickets! There will be MANY chances to win something!

The Outer Sunset Farmers Market & Mercantile is every Sunday from 9am to 2pm, rain (or fog) or shine, at 37th Ave & Pacheco St in San Francisco. Find fresh produce, hot food, all-ages arts & crafts at Artship, and seasonal programming!

Learn how to the flavors found in Indian cuisine in your own kitchen. Hands-on. For ages 18+. You’ll work in small teams during class.

About this Event

Age RestrictionsFor ages 18 & up

DescriptionIf you love Indian food and have wondered how to recreate those flavors in your own home, this is the class for you! While the South Asian/Indian culinary diaspora is incredibly diverse, we’re here to lessen the intimidation factor and help you get to know the key spices, knife skills, essential sauces, and cooking methods to get you started.
We’ll pay homage to Madhur Jaffrey, multiple James Beard Award-winner known as the Godmother of Indian Cooking for introducing many people to Indian food in America. Using her approach, we’ll keep class fun, easy, and delicious at every turn. At the end of class everyone will get to sit down and enjoy a meal together.
You will be working in a small group. For ages 18 and up. 21 or older? You’ll enjoy a glass of wine or beer paired with your meal.

MenuLamb Vindaloo
Shahi Murgh (Royal Chicken Cooked in Yogurt)
Massor Dal (Red Lentils Tarka)
Matar Aur Sooay Ka Pullao (Rice with Peas and Dill)
Hari Chutney (Fresh Green Chutney)
Sev ka Murabba (Carmelized Cardamom Apples with Pistachio Cream)

Safety & Precautions
At check-in, you will be asked to sign a waiver before entering the Cooking School.

long_description:
✨ What if healing didn’t have to be complicated… and could begin with just a few simple, powerful words?

🌺 About the Experience

Ho’oponopono is a traditional Hawaiian healing practice centered on forgiveness, responsibility, and emotional release. This 60-minute guided class introduces you to a deeply soothing mantra-based meditation designed to support emotional clearing and inner peace.

You’ll be gently guided through the Ho’oponopono mantra:

“I’m sorry.

Please forgive me.

Thank you.

I love you.”

As you repeat and embody these words, you’ll begin to release emotional weight, soften inner tension, and create space for compassion, healing, and self-love.

This practice can support you in many areas of life. Whether you’re processing relationships, letting go of old patterns, or simply seeking more calm and balance within yourself.

🌿 What to Expect:

• A grounding introduction to the Ho’oponopono practice and its meaning

• Guided mantra meditation for emotional release and forgiveness

• Gentle support in releasing emotional blocks and stored tension

• A quiet space for integration, reflection, and inner stillness

• Optional sharing and journaling time after the meditation

💫 This Practice Supports:

• Emotional healing and release

• Forgiveness and self-compassion

• Inner peace and nervous system calming

• Clarity, softness, and energetic balance

🌸 What to Bring:

• A journal or notebook for reflection

• Water or tea for comfort

• Comfortable clothing

• An open heart and willingness to receive

✨ No experience needed just come as you are.

long_description:
w/ Special Guests Patti Ann Kelly, Willow, MaaShakti Das, and Claire Moore! Alsi Di Pini Prasad provided by Bombay Sweets~

Soul-Nourishing Kirtan: A Night of Inner Peace, Healing, Music, and Community Song with Touring Sadhaka Jordan Loder

Breathe, Heal, Laugh, Cry, Sing, Release, Connect. 

Jordan is currently on his 49-date “Singing Our Hearts Wide Open” Tour across the United States, Canada, and Hawaii. This is one of the stops on that journey.

A touring bhakti artist who has devoted his life to spreading the joy of inner peace through the power of music, Jordan spent nearly a decade on the road supporting beloved artists Snatam Kaur, Deva Premal & Miten, Ajeet, Simrit, and Adam Bauer as tour manager and sound engineer. He now carries that living tradition forward as he travels the world offering his own unique and refreshing style of devotional music.

His heartfelt kirtan (call-and-response singing) is known for its tender, authentic, and introspective quality, igniting an experience of profound healing and a genuine sense of togetherness. With an effortless lightness of being and a childlike spirit of wonder, you will be swept away into a state of total spiritual oneness.

He travels with professional sound, ambient lighting, and projected lyrics, presented with a production sense refined over more than two decades working behind the scenes for some of music’s most legendary artists.

“A true Bhakti yogi, his kirtan transmits unconditional love & devotion and delivers us to an ecstatic experience of the Great Universal Spirit.”

— GuruGanesha, Founder, Spirit Voyage Music

Don’t miss this special opportunity to open your heart and reconnect through music and the healing power of sound. You will form and deepen lasting relationships with amazing people. We would LOVE to have you join us, and promise that you will never forget this one-of-a-kind experience!

long_description:
Experience the Vibrance of Punjabi Culture at the Boston Bhangra Competition
Mark your calendars for the 14th of November, 2026 as the city of Boston comes alive with the infectious energy and vibrant colors of the Boston Bhangra Competition. The Strand Theatre will be pulsating with the rhythmic beats of Bhangra, a Punjabi dance form, as the best teams from across North America showcase their talent. Organized by the South Asian Nation, this multilingual event is an absolute treat for lovers of dance and music.
Unleashing the Power of Dance with No Boundaries
The Boston Bhangra Competition does not feature a specific artist, instead, it is a platform where numerous talented artists come together to celebrate and promote the Punjabi culture. Each team brings a unique take on the traditional Bhangra, captivating the audience with their high-energy performances. It is not just a competition, but a celebration of diversity, unity, and the rich cultural heritage of Punjab.
Immerse in the Cultural Extravaganza at Strand Theatre
The event will take place at the historic Strand Theatre, located at 543 Columbia Rd Dorchester, Boston, MA, United States. The venue is well-known for its safety and easy accessibility. It's an ideal location to enjoy the rhythmic beats of Bhangra. The venue is surrounded by a number of Indian restaurants, perfect for grabbing a quick bite before or after the event. Parking is also available for those who prefer to drive.
Secure Your Seats Today!
Tickets are available in various tiers to suit everyone's budget. VIP tickets are priced at $100.00 for those who want an exclusive experience. Tier 1 tickets are available at $50.00, Tier 2 at $40.00, Tier 3 at $30.00, Tier 4 at $25.00, and Tier 5 at $20.00. Additionally, dinner tickets can be purchased for $15.00. Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to immerse yourself in a night of electrifying Bhangra performances. Reserve your seats today!

title: Silent Disco at Domain: Bollywood, Tollywood, & Everything in Between
description: Get ready to dance the night away with silent beats from Bollywood to Tollywood and all the cool vibes underneath the stary night!
long_description:
Get ready to dance the night away with silent beats from Bollywood to Tollywood and all the cool vibes underneath the stary night!

About this Event

Headphones on, Austin. Bollywood, Tollywood and everything in between, at The Domain, Amy Donovan Plaza.
Overview
When the sun goes down on Panchabhootam, the plaza turns into a dance floor.
Join SAIVA on Saturday, November 14, from 8:30 to 9:30 PM for a silent disco at The Domain's Amy Donovan Plaza. Bollywood, Tollywood, and everything in between, playing straight into your headphones under the open Texas sky.
This is the closing celebration of Panchabhootam, SAIVA's festival of the five great elements: earth, water, fire, air and space. All afternoon, the elements come alive through the senses. The silent disco ends the day with sound, the sense of space, and everyone dancing together.
At SAIVA, we believe every generation has something to give and something to learn. So bring your grandmother, your kids, your college roommate and your neighbors. Some of our best dancers have been practicing in our weekly classes since May.
How it works
When you arrive, you'll pick up a pair of wireless headphones. 3 channels each play a different mix, and the light on your headset shows which one you're tuned to, so you can find the people dancing to your song.
Want to talk? Slide one ear off. No shouting over speakers, and no ringing ears on the drive home. It's the most social way to dance.
Make a day of it
Come early for the free Panchabhootam festival from 3 to 6 PM at the same plaza:
Experience the elementsDance performancesSeed ball creation, art, and fermentation activitiesFood for purchase and a marketFamily activities for all agesGood to know

description:
🕉️ What is Kirtan? ✨

long_description:
🕉️ What is Kirtan? ✨

Kirtan is an ancient sacred practice of mantra chanting, where voices, music, and hearts come together in Divine vibration.

Through call-and-response chanting, we repeat sacred Sanskrit mantras, allowing the mind to become quiet and the heart to open.

You don’t need to know how to sing or understand Sanskrit. Just bring your beautiful self and allow the music to carry you.

Kirtan is a form of Bhakti Yoga, the yoga of love and devotion. ❤️

When we chant together, we create something magical. Our individual voices become one, reminding us that we are all connected.

long_description:
Science of Spirituality Presents:

Thanksgiving Gratitude Series: Let’s explore the real meaning of Thanksgiving.

Nov 14: Why be grateful? Explore how gratitude can enrich your life.

Gratitude is more than just a positive emotion; it is a powerful practice that can improve our mental, emotional, and physical well-being. Research shows that grateful people often experience greater happiness, stronger relationships, better sleep, and reduced stress. In this workshop, we will explore the science and spirituality of gratitude and learn how a simple shift in perspective can transform the way we experience life. The session will include reflection, discussion, and guided meditation.

title: Seat at the Table: South Asians Rise in American Politics - Film and Talk
venue_name: The City College of New York
description: Seat at the Table documents the rise of South Asian Americans in U.S. politics, tracing their  journey from the margins towards power.
long_description:
Seat at the Table documents the rise of South Asian Americans in U.S. politics, tracing their journey from the margins towards power.

About this Event

Seat at the Table follows several prominent South Asian political candidates during the 2024 election cycle, alongside a community galvanized by the groundbreaking campaign of the first South Asian presidential candidate. Within a hundred years, South Asians in America have gone from being disenfranchised, to seeing the first South Asian presidential candidate on a major party’s ticket.
Join us to see thsi film and hear from the filmmakers and others on rise of South Asians in this arena. 
When: Thursday, Nov 19th at 6 PM
Where: City College of NY, Shepard Hall, Room 291 (second floor)
259 Convent Avenue at 140th Street (SE Corner) ID needed to enter the building.
To get there: #1 to 137th street, ABCD to 145th Street. Accessible mode: #6 to 125th Street, M101 to 140th street. 
Building and theater is accessible. CART available. Light Refreshments.
Presented by Third World Newsrteel, the Documentary Forum at CCNY and AAARI (Asian American/Asian Research Institute at CUNY)

With unprecedented access to congressional and state-level campaigns, as well as grassroots organizing efforts, the film captures a historic year for the South Asian diaspora as more candidates than ever run for office, providing us a rare front-row seat to an immigrant community awakening to its power in America.

Our distinguished Key Speakers include the charming goats - Nigerian Dwarf and Mini Silky Fainting ready to share their love and positive energy with all attendees.

Escape the routine and immerse yourself in a therapy session with nature. Whether you prefer to nap or play there's something for everyone. Simply relax in a lawn chair or hammock cuddle with a goat and watch your worries fade away. Feel the magic as time slips by and anxiety melts away in the serene farm setting.

This event is family-friendly so bring your loved ones and make cherished memories together. Please remember to bring your own beverage as our furry friends have a penchant for nibbling on snacks!

title: Special Program: Counter-Histories—Memory, Materiality & South Asian Art
description: Syona Puliady and UCLA Arts Dean Lionel Popkin discuss South Asian art, material, memory, and reimagined histories.
long_description:
Syona Puliady and UCLA Arts Dean Lionel Popkin discuss South Asian art, material, memory, and reimagined histories.

About this Event

Curator of Textiles of the Eastern Hemisphere Syona Puliady will join UCLA Dean of the School of the Arts and Architecture Lionel Popkin for a conversation on the themes underlying Textiles as Monument and Field Notes from Begumpura: memory, materiality, and the creation of alternative histories through contemporary art.

By focusing on the works of Suchitra Mattai, Jagdeep Raina, Swapnaa Tamhane, and Rahee Punyashloka, Puliady and Popkin will consider how artists use textiles, speculative storytelling, archival practices, and other forms of cultural expression to challenge dominant narratives and center communities whose histories have often been overlooked. Together, they will address how contemporary South Asian artists create new forms of remembrance, belonging, and possibility through material and imagined worlds.

Lionel Popkin is the dean of the UCLA School of the Arts and Architecture and a professor of choreography in the UCLA Department of World Arts and Cultures/Dance. He previously served as the school’s associate dean for academic affairs (2021–24) and chair of the World Arts and Cultures/Dance department (2015–18). Popkin’s artistic practice engages people, objects, and media to explore hybridity, archival practices, and the complexities of representing the South Asian diaspora in North America. His performance and video artworks have been presented at leading cultural venues on four continents, and his written works have been included in scholarly journals and arts publications. He joined UCLA's faculty in 2006 and is a resident artist at the 18th Street Arts Center.

description: Path to Enlightenment: Live Bhagavad Gita Classes for Spiritual Awakening Classes will guide you through complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual wisdom. An ongoing in-depth course deliving into profound wisdom within Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Hindu/Indian/Vedic spiritual philosophy, and Upanishads. You can see prior recordings at: YesVedanta.com/bg2 Timeless Wisdom of Bhagavad Gita: A Complete Course in Non-Duality in 700 Verses Join us for an in-depth exploration of the Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Vedantic wisdom. Our weekly live Zoom classes will guide you through the complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual knowledge. The Bhagavad Gita, a dialogue between Krishna (the teacher) and Arjuna (the student), addresses life's deepest questions: What is the nature of the Self? What is the highest purpose of existence? How can one live with intelligence and clarity? If all existence is One, why do we perceive differences? What is the nature of the universe and its origin? How can we understand the cause of the universe? How does one transcend the sense of limitation? This comprehensive study covers: The nature of the Self (Atman) and Reality (Brahman) Self-knowledge that includes dozens of methods to reveal your nature The role of karma, dharma, and free will The nature of the mind and consciousness (or awareness) The art of wise living and decision-making Cultivating emotional maturity and inner peace Through this course, you will: Grasp the core teachings of the Bhagavad Gita and their relevance to modern life Apply practical techniques for refining your thinking and mastering your emotions Develop a deeper understanding of your identity and the world Cultivate inner peace, clarity, and purpose This knowledge offers a step-by-step method to liberate the seeker from the confines of the ego, from the limitations imposed by the material world, and from the cycle of rebirth. TRIVUJ মানে গান ft. Aithrios

Trivuj is bringing Aithrios to Raleigh for a night of Bengali rock at Cannonball Music Hall. Based in the Maryland/DC area, Aithrios plays a mix of original songs and covers from bands like Artcell, LRB, Warfaze, Nemesis, and Miles. If Bengali rock has a place in your playlist, this is a chance to hear it live.

Trivuj – Triangle Music Project started with a simple idea: bring people together through Bengali music. We want to keep Bangla music alive in our community, give musicians opportunities to perform, and create spaces where music lovers can connect. From jam sessions to live concerts, Trivuj মানে গান is about the music and the people who make it matter.

Join us on Saturday, November 21, for a night of live rock and a gathering of the Bengali music community in the Triangle.

title: Bollywood Dance Cardio with Priya
description: Get ready to dance and sweat with Priya’s fun and energetic Bollycardio workout session!
long_description:
Get ready to dance and sweat with Priya’s fun and energetic Bollycardio workout session!

About this Event

Bollycardio with PriyaGet ready to sweat and smile at Bollycardio with Priya! This fun, high-energy workout combines heart-pumping Bollywood dance moves with cardio exercises that will leave you feeling amazing. Perfect for all fitness levels, it's an awesome way to boost your mood and get moving. Join us in person and dance your way to a fitter, happier you. Don't miss out on the fun—Priya's got the beats and moves to keep you grooving! Burn calories before gaining calories for Thanksgiving. 

About the instructor:
Priya Iyer is a versatile and seasoned LA-based dancer with almost 20 years of experience in various dance styles, including ballet, tap, jazz, modern, gymnastics/flexibility, Bharatnatyam, musical theatre, Bollywood, Indo-contemporary, semi-classical, and Indian fusion. Her undergraduate training included a focus in musical theatre, and her degree reflects a dance minor. She has performed in most of her trained forms in recitals, theatrical shows, stage performances, TV appearances, and dedicated dance videos. She also has experience teaching the noted South Asian dance forms. Noteworthy credits and companies include Doonya (NYC, instructor), Ithaca College Theatre Arts (NY), Hypokrit Theatre Company (NYC), Sanskruti Dance (NJ), Junoon Performing Arts (NYC), Tamasha (NYC), Dance Drama Dramatics (NYC), and Adaa Dance Project (USA).

Also check out other in Los Angeles, Arts events in Los Angeles, Theatre events in Los Angeles.

venue_name: 3128 Greenmount Avenue, Baltimore, MD, United States, Maryland 21218
description:
Harjant Gill presents "Coming of Age in Macholand: Masculinity, Patriarchy, and the Search for Freedom in Indian Punjab," in conversation with Manil Suri

Through Punjabi men’s struggles to marry, migrate, love, and escape, COMING OF AGE IN MACHOLAND reveals what patriarchy costs the men it promises
long_description:
Harjant Gill presents "Coming of Age in Macholand: Masculinity, Patriarchy, and the Search for Freedom in Indian Punjab," in conversation with Manil Suri

Through Punjabi men’s struggles to marry, migrate, love, and escape, COMING OF AGE IN MACHOLAND reveals what patriarchy costs the men it promises to empower.

In 2019, Sandeep, a twenty-seven-year-old from a Punjabi family, killed five relatives and himself after a date was set for his wedding. His suicide note described feeling trapped by social expectations and condemned to a life he had not chosen. Harjant Gill recognized something unsettling in his story. Gill grew up in Punjab as the eldest grandson of a Sikh patriarch before immigrating to California as a teenager. Although he built an openly gay life in Washington, DC, he returned to the closet for safety while researching in India, even as his grandfather sought a “suitable” bride for him. Gill could refuse marriage and return to America, but many men he met had no easy exit. What happens when patriarchy promises men power while denying them the freedom to choose who they will become?

Coming of Age in Macholand explores how young men respond to patriarchy—submitting, rebelling, escaping, and sometimes coming undone. Drawing on four years of research, conducted over a decade, Gill enters the worlds of Punjabi boys learning to become men, where masculinity is shaped through violence yet sustained by emotional bonds. Amid political upheaval, a faltering agrarian economy, and migration hollowing out Punjab’s villages, the book portrays men struggling for power while losing intimacy and control over their lives. Blending memoir, ethnography, and social investigation, Gill exposes a system that brutalizes women and queer people while constricting the men it claims to serve. At a moment when men feel angry, lonely, and adrift, the book asks what they must relinquish—and reclaim—to become truly free.

The race weekend features a full marathon, half marathon, ultra marathon, 5-person relay, 10K, and 5K — something for every runner. title: Quick & Easy Indian Cooking
description: Learn how to the flavors found in Indian cuisine in your own kitchen. Hands-on. For ages 18+. You’ll work in small teams during class.
long_description:
Learn how to the flavors found in Indian cuisine in your own kitchen. Hands-on. For ages 18+. You’ll work in small teams during class.

About this Event

Age RestrictionsFor ages 18 & up

DescriptionIf you love Indian food and have wondered how to recreate those flavors in your own home, this is the class for you! While the South Asian/Indian culinary diaspora is incredibly diverse, we’re here to lessen the intimidation factor and help you get to know the key spices, knife skills, essential sauces, and cooking methods to get you started.
We’ll pay homage to Madhur Jaffrey, multiple James Beard Award-winner known as the Godmother of Indian Cooking for introducing many people to Indian food in America. Using her approach, we’ll keep class fun, easy, and delicious at every turn. At the end of class everyone will get to sit down and enjoy a meal together.
You will be working in a small group. For ages 18 and up. 21 or older? You’ll enjoy a glass of wine or beer paired with your meal.

MenuLamb Vindaloo
Shahi Murgh (Royal Chicken Cooked in Yogurt)
Massor Dal (Red Lentils Tarka)
Matar Aur Sooay Ka Pullao (Rice with Peas and Dill)
Hari Chutney (Fresh Green Chutney)
Sev ka Murabba (Carmelized Cardamom Apples with Pistachio Cream)

Safety & Precautions
At check-in, you will be asked to sign a waiver before entering the Cooking School.
For that reason, we ask that all attendees arrive at least 5 minutes prior to the confirmed start time of the class.

Find FAQs about our in-store classes here.

title: San Diego Tamil Sangam Annual Membership 2026
description: Experience the Vibrance of Tamil Culture at the San Diego Tamil Sangam Annual Membership 2026
long_description:
Experience the Vibrance of Tamil Culture at the San Diego Tamil Sangam Annual Membership 2026
Mark your calendars for December 31st, 2026, as on this day, the San Diego Tamil Sangam will host its highly anticipated Annual Membership event. A cultural extravaganza that celebrates the richness and diversity of Tamil heritage, this event is a golden opportunity for Tamil enthusiasts to come together and revel in the vibrancy of this ancient culture. The event is sure to be a hub of engagement, enrichment, and entertainment that fosters the promotion and preservation of Tamil language, arts, and literature.
Artist: A Secret Yet to be Revealed
The event is yet to announce its artist, but it's known for featuring renowned individuals from the Tamil community who have significantly influenced the preservation and promotion of Tamil culture. The mystery guest, no doubt, will offer a memorable experience, showcasing the beauty of Tamil arts and literature that resonates with the audience and deepens their appreciation for this rich culture.
Immerse Yourself in Tamil Culture in the Heart of San Diego
The event takes place in San Diego, California, specifically at the 750 B Street location. The venue is in an easily accessible area of the city, known for its safety and proximity to a variety of attractions. After the event, guests can explore the city's vibrant nightlife, historical landmarks, and breathtaking beaches. And for those craving authentic Indian cuisine, there are numerous Indian restaurants nearby where you can indulge in a variety of flavorful dishes.
Secure Your Membership: Ticket Information
Various membership options are available for purchase, ensuring there's something for everyone. The Annual Family Membership is priced at $60.00, providing an excellent opportunity for families to be part of the Tamil community in San Diego. The Annual Individual Membership is available for $35.00, perfect for individuals passionate about Tamil culture. Additionally, the Student Membership from India is priced at a discounted rate of $10.00. For those who want to make a long-term commitment, the Lifetime Membership is available for $500.00. Make sure to secure your membership and be part of the San Diego Tamil Sangam's thriving community.

long_description:
Ring in 2027 with us!

Expect to hear our signature blend of Global Bass bangers, from Bhangra to Dembow, Future Filmi/Bollywood, Reggaeton, Cumbia, Desi Bass and more.

Few DJs can be said to have changed the sound of their city but that is exactly what DJ Anjali and The Incredible Kid have done since they first introduced Portland nightclubs to the many varied sounds of the Latin & Desi diaspora at a rowdy New Year’s Eve debut in 2000.

They are most known for incinerating dance floors with the heavy dance floor artillery of South Asia, but the duo scour the globe for any hard-hitting music that combines local music traditions with window-rattling production. 

In the ensuing twenty-six years they have ignited dance floors across the West Coast to India and NYC. In 2002 they founded ANDAZ, Portland’s first Bhangra and Bollywood party. For ten years (2003-2013) alongside E3, they ran the PNW’s first Global Bass monthly, ATLAS. Their love of Panjabi folk and Bollywood bangers alongside Cumbia, Dembow, Reggaeton and Baile continues monthly at TROPITAAL! A Desi Latine Soundclash (since 2013) and Anjali currently hosts Chai & Roses at Holocene.

“There’s truly never a bad time to see the legendary duo effortlessly smashing the sounds and grooves of Latin America and India together” Portland Mercury 7/10/26

“Would you believe that we’ve had the gift of DJ Anjali and The Incredible Kid for 25 years? The duo originally debuted at a New Year’s Eve party, so there’s no better time to celebrate their continued contributions to the Portland dance scene than during NYE. You’ve probably caught them at a club or community fest over the years, sharing their love for the danceable beats of Latin and South Asian music . . . They craft energetic and infectious sets packed with everything from Bollywood bangers to Reggaeton hits.” Portland Mercury 12/31/25

“DJ Anjali and The Incredible Kid aren’t exactly under-the-radar among clubgoers ‘round these parts, and there’s a good reason

About this Event

Use Hindi to open doors of success and invest in self-development
Who is training?
Pooja Chandna is an experienced online Hindi language coach with experience of teaching Hindi to international students interested in beginning to advanced level Hindi.

Please follow above page for more upcoming sessions and classes or for tips on learning Hindi.

Why learn Hindi in a structured way?
Hindi is 3rd largest spoken language in the world with 615 million speakers. Work on certification in Hindi to help with college admissions or pursue other goals. Trainer for the course, Pooja Chandna, has a background in psychology and dramatics and has stayed in multiple countries. The course will be structured in such a way that you will get more than just learn a language. You learn listening, speaking, reading and writing. Beyond that, you also learn the Indian way of solving problems, working out relations and seeking contentment and joy in the simplicity of life.

What is the goal of this free class?
The first class is to help you discover your interest in the Hindi language, ability to commit to it and evaluate the trainer's pedagogical capability. Also, if you are returning to India and need your kid to be ready to study in India, you can get tips in this class. If you like the class and would like to sign up for private paid lessons, you can let the trainer, Pooja, know. The timing and price will be shared after the class.

Use games and activities to learn new vocabulary, recognise words and more importantly, feel it in your heart. You learn, without even realising it. In 2024, he made his late-night debut on The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, and in 2025 released his first
long_description:
Usama Siddiquee is a Bengali-American stand-up comedian, writer, and actor based in New York City. He is currently a finalist on Kevin Hart’s Funny AF for Netflix, which premiered on April 20. In 2024, he made his late-night debut on The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, and in 2025 released his first half-hour special with Don’t Tell Comedy on YouTube. The special highlights his signature high-energy, rapid-fire style, with material ranging from growing up Muslim in Texas to dating misadventures and even getting kicked off America’s Got Talent.

As an actor, Usama has appeared in Netflix’s Inventing Anna and Survival of the Thickest, HBO’s And Just Like That, Comedy Central’s Awkwafina Is Nora from Queens, and FX’s Better Things. He recently wrapped a supporting role in the upcoming Netflix comedy Best of the Best, alongside Hasan Minhaj, Priyanka Kedia, and Maitreyi Ramakrishnan.

Usama was named a New Face at the prestigious Just For Laughs Festival in 2018. In 2020, he reached the semifinals of America’s Got Talent and appeared in the ABC Discovers Talent Showcase. A decorated festival performer, he was a finalist in the 2017 New York’s Funniest competition at Caroline’s and the NBC Stand-Up competition, and has won top honors at the Laughing Devil Cup Comedy Festival (2016), Yonkers Comedy Festival (2015), and Make Me Laugh Albany Comedy Festival (2015). His work has also been featured by NBC, BuzzFeed, Refinery29, The Scene, Mic.com, FusionTV, and The Huffington Post.

long_description:
The Wedding & Bridal Expo in Hartford is a premier event that showcases a wide range of services and products for couples preparing for their special day. Organized by Jenks Productions, this annual expo is held at the Connecticut Convention Center and attracts over two hundred local and national wedding vendors. Participants can explore a variety of offerings, including wedding dresses, bridal veils, bridesmaid and mother-of-the-bride dresses, wedding planners, floral arrangements, and decorations. The expo is designed to streamline the wedding planning process, allowing busy couples to find all they need under one roof. With multiple options available for each product and service, attendees can choose from various styles and price points to fit their preferences and budgets.

The event features an array of stage shows throughout the day, where attendees can view the latest trends in bridal fashion. Notable exhibitors include Olena’s Bridal Boutique & Alterations, Bella Bridesmaid West Hartford, and The Bridal Salon at Corrine Weddings, among others. Entertainment highlights include performances by talented musicians such as saxophonist Quinn Mitchell and DJs from MNE Events. Attendees will also have the chance to win exciting prizes, including gift certificates for various local services and products. With its reputation as a vital resource for wedding planning, the Wedding & Bridal Expo in Hartford is an essential experience for couples looking to make their wedding dreams a reality.

Usama Siddiquee
description:
Usama Siddiquee is a Bengali-American stand-up comedian, writer, and actor based in New York City, who can most recently be seen as a finalist (and fan favorite!) on Kevin Hart’s new series for Netflix, Funny AF.

As an actor, Usama can be seen scene-stealing in Netflix’s Inventing Anna and Survival
long_description:
Usama Siddiquee is a Bengali-American stand-up comedian, writer, and actor based in New York City, who can most recently be seen as a finalist (and fan favorite!) on Kevin Hart’s new series for Netflix, Funny AF.

As an actor, Usama can be seen scene-stealing in Netflix’s Inventing Anna and Survival of the Thickest, HBO’s And Just Like That, Comedy Central’s Awkwafina Is Nora from Queens, and FX’s Better Things. He recently wrapped a supporting role in the upcoming Netflix comedy Best of the Best, alongside Hasan Minhaj, Priyanka Kedia, and Maitreyi Ramakrishnan.

In 2024, Usama made his late-night debut on The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, and in 2025 released his first half-hour special with Don’t Tell Comedy on YouTube. The special highlights his signature high-energy, rapid-fire style, with material ranging from growing up Muslim in Texas to dating misadventures and even getting kicked off America’s Got Talent. Usama was named a New Face at the prestigious Just For Laughs Festival in 2018.
